Alvaro Montero.note: Montero gives Colombia a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Alvaro Montero.noteZh: 他在Colombia首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Andres Gomez.note: Gómez gives Colombia a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Andres Gomez.noteZh: 他是Colombia在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Camilo Vargas.note: Vargas has carried the keeper minutes for Colombia. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Camilo Vargas.noteZh: 他是Colombia防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。

Cucho Hernandez.note: Hernández has one tournament assist in the bank for Colombia. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Cucho Hernandez.noteZh: 他已经帮Colombia制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Daniel Munoz.note: Muñoz has already punished Uzbekistan and DR Congo for Colombia. The watch point is how little room he needs once the chance is alive.
Daniel Munoz.noteZh: 他已经是Colombia这届世界杯的真实得分故事之一。他的危险在于防守者还没处理完第一个问题，他已经到位。

David Ospina.note: Ospina sits behind the starter for Colombia, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
David Ospina.noteZh: 他给Colombia保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Davinson Sanchez.note: Sánchez has been part of Colombia's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Davinson Sanchez.noteZh: 他在Colombia体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Deiver Machado.note: Machado is back-line insurance for Colombia. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Deiver Machado.noteZh: 他给Colombia那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Gustavo Puerta.note: Puerta has already created a goal for Colombia in this tournament. Watch the timing of his release, because the pass often matters more than the carry.
Gustavo Puerta.noteZh: 他已经参与了Colombia的一粒世界杯进球。那脚传球的意义，是在防守者完全转身前到达。

James Rodriguez.note: Rodríguez has been one of Colombia's midfield connectors in this tournament. He keeps the next pass alive and helps the team avoid rushed choices.
James Rodriguez.noteZh: 他是Colombia让控球不散掉的球员之一。看点是他多早就知道下一脚传给谁。

Jaminton Campaz.note: Campaz already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Uzbekistan. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Jaminton Campaz.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Jefferson Lerma.note: Lerma is in the quiet-work part of Colombia's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Jefferson Lerma.noteZh: 他是Colombia主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Jhon Arias.note: Arias's World Cup has already included a goal against Ghana. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Jhon Arias.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Jhon Cordoba.note: Córdoba is an attacking change-up for Colombia. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Jhon Cordoba.noteZh: 他是Colombia的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Jhon Lucumi.note: Lucumí has been part of Colombia's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Jhon Lucumi.noteZh: 他在Colombia体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Johan Mojica.note: Mojica is in the quiet-work part of Colombia's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Johan Mojica.noteZh: 他是Colombia主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Jorge Carrascal.note: Carrascal is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Colombia, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Jorge Carrascal.noteZh: 他给Colombia提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Juan Portilla.note: Portilla is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Colombia, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Juan Portilla.noteZh: 他给Colombia提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Juan Quintero.note: Quintero has one tournament assist in the bank for Colombia. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Juan Quintero.noteZh: 他已经帮Colombia制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Kevin Castano.note: Castaño gives Colombia midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Kevin Castano.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Colombia来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Luis Diaz.note: Díaz has already given Colombia a goal and a setup in this tournament. Defenders have to read shot and pass at the same time.
Luis Diaz.noteZh: 他给Colombia展示了进攻工作的两面。一脚拉开防守，下一脚就可能决定机会。

Luis Suarez.note: Suárez has supplied one of Colombia's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Luis Suarez.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Colombia创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Richard Rios.note: Ríos gives Colombia midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Richard Rios.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Colombia来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Santiago Arias.noteZh: 他给Colombia那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Willer Ditta.note: Ditta gives Colombia cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Willer Ditta.noteZh: 他是Colombia后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。
